events.evidence: Voting begins for the 2004 U.S. presidential election, as well as for elections to the U.S. Congress and many state and local offices.
Iraqi officials report at least eight dead in a car bomb outside the education ministry in Baghdad.
Controversial Dutch filmmaker Theo van Gogh is stabbed and shot dead in Amsterdam; the suspected murderer is arrested after a firefight with police.

label.note: Election uncertainty and routine Iraq violence keep risk appetite neutral.
